concerns.text: The 'Verified Datasets' section lists three HuggingFace URLs (autoevaluate, masashi-hatano, argilla-internal-testing) that are unrelated to the project's mathematical domain (squarefree gaps). The plan explicitly states 'No external data sources are required' and generates data in-memory. These irrelevant citations should be removed to avoid confusion and maintain data hygiene, as they do not serve the project's purpose.
